name: FAQ — expandable list
description: Two-tone display heading (muted lead + foreground) and spacious divider rows built on native <details>: each item has a description and an optional link, with an optional link below the list. Smooth expansion in pure CSS (::details-content + interpolate-size), no GSAP in the interaction.

contentSlots.titleLead: first part of the heading (muted, with a period)
contentSlots.title: second part of the heading (foreground)
contentSlots.defaultOpen: indexes of pre-opened items (SSR open); default [] — all collapsed
